system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 1 hour, 15 Spell Uses. Lasts: Indefinitely. Turns the target into a Dairygirl (small horns, cow ears and tail). It can no longer wear Full or Fitted armour but gives a serving of milk (+1 Brawn for 24 hours) after eating four rations. Target must be a Human, Elf, Relmer or Alloyan. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
